name: HUD-3
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Compact date/time, age and money in a left top commuter-pass, tiny survival gauges and one mission strip. Korean apartment world dominates. Interaction and navigation along edges. A concise transit timetable composition; broad typography, ruled bands and economical paper labels.
